title: Reading Comprehension and Text Interpretation — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: Mangrove news: Which statement does NOT match the news?

stimulus.text: SURABAYA - On Monday, 300 students from 12 schools planted 2,000 mangrove seedlings at Wonorejo beach. The event aimed to protect the coast from erosion.

visual.text: The seedlings were planted by farmers.

choices.say: The seedlings were planted by farmers.

visual.text: Students from twelve schools took part.

choices.say: Students from twelve schools took part.

visual.text: The goal was to protect the coast.

choices.say: The goal was to protect the coast.

items.reteach: Yang menanam adalah 300 pelajar, bukan petani.

items.prompt: Mangrove news — a student's summary: "On Monday, 300 students planted 2,000 seedlings to stop floods in the city." Which part is kurang tepat?

stimulus.text: SURABAYA - On Monday, 300 students from 12 schools planted 2,000 mangrove seedlings at Wonorejo beach. The event aimed to protect the coast from erosion.

visual.text: to stop floods in the city

choices.say: to stop floods in the city

items.reteach: Tujuan dalam berita: melindungi pantai dari abrasi (erosion), bukan banjir kota.

items.prompt: Robotics news: Which statement does NOT match the news?

stimulus.text: MALANG - A Grade 8 student, Fajar Nugroho, won gold at a national robotics contest last week. His robot sorts waste into paper, plastic, and metal.

visual.text: Fajar's robot sorts waste into glass and food.

choices.say: Fajar's robot sorts waste into glass and food.

visual.text: The contest was a national one.

choices.say: The contest was a national one.

items.reteach: Robot Fajar memilah sampah kertas, plastik, dan logam.

items.prompt: Robotics news — a summary: "Last week, a Grade 8 student from Malang won silver with a robot that sorts waste." Which part is kurang tepat?

stimulus.text: MALANG - A Grade 8 student, Fajar Nugroho, won gold at a national robotics contest last week. His robot sorts waste into paper, plastic, and metal.

items.reteach: Berita menyebut Fajar meraih emas (gold).

items.prompt: Landslide news: Which statement does NOT match the news?

stimulus.text: BANYUWANGI - Heavy rain on Tuesday night caused a small landslide on the road to Ijen. No one was hurt, but the road was closed for six hours.

visual.text: The road was closed for some hours.

choices.say: The road was closed for some hours.

items.reteach: "No one was hurt" berarti tidak ada korban luka.

items.prompt: Landslide news — a summary: "Heavy rain caused a landslide on the Ijen road, which was closed for six days. No one was hurt." Which part is kurang tepat?

stimulus.text: BANYUWANGI - Heavy rain on Tuesday night caused a small landslide on the road to Ijen. No one was hurt, but the road was closed for six hours.

items.reteach: Jalan ditutup enam jam, bukan enam hari.

items.prompt: Fun run news: Which statement does NOT match the news?

stimulus.text: MADURA - The Suramadu Bridge will host a fun run on Sunday. About 5,000 runners are expected. Cars and motorbikes cannot use the bridge from 5 to 9 a.m.

visual.text: Vehicles may cross the bridge during the run.

choices.say: Vehicles may cross the bridge during the run.

visual.text: The run takes place on Sunday.

choices.say: The run takes place on Sunday.

visual.text: The bridge is closed to vehicles for four hours.

choices.say: The bridge is closed to vehicles for four hours.

items.reteach: Mobil dan motor tidak boleh lewat pukul 05.00–09.00 (empat jam).

items.prompt: Fun run news — a summary: "A fun run on the Suramadu Bridge on Sunday will close it to vehicles from 5 to 9 a.m. About 500 runners will take part." Which part is kurang tepat?

stimulus.text: MADURA - The Suramadu Bridge will host a fun run on Sunday. About 5,000 runners are expected. Cars and motorbikes cannot use the bridge from 5 to 9 a.m.

items.reteach: Berita memperkirakan sekitar 5.000 pelari.

items.prompt: Library news: Which statement does NOT match the news?

stimulus.text: JEMBER - The city library now stays open until 9 p.m. on weekdays. The head librarian said many students had asked for a place to study after school.

visual.text: The library now closes earlier than before.

choices.say: The library now closes earlier than before.

visual.text: It stays open late on weekdays.

choices.say: It stays open late on weekdays.

visual.text: Students wanted a place to study after school.

choices.say: Students wanted a place to study after school.

visual.text: The head librarian gave a statement.

choices.say: The head librarian gave a statement.

items.reteach: Perpustakaan justru buka lebih lama, sampai pukul 21.00.

items.prompt: Library news — a summary: "The Jember city library now opens until 9 p.m. on weekends because students asked for it." Which part is kurang tepat?

stimulus.text: JEMBER - The city library now stays open until 9 p.m. on weekdays. The head librarian said many students had asked for a place to study after school.

items.reteach: Berita menyebut hari kerja (weekdays), bukan akhir pekan.

items.prompt: Apple harvest news: Which statement does NOT match the news?

stimulus.text: BATU - Apple farmers harvested 30% less fruit this year. They blamed unusually heavy rain during the flowering season.

visual.text: The harvest was bigger than usual.

choices.say: The harvest was bigger than usual.

visual.text: Rain fell during the flowering season.

choices.say: Rain fell during the flowering season.

items.reteach: "30% less fruit" berarti panen berkurang.

items.prompt: Apple harvest news — a summary: "Apple farmers in Batu harvested 30% more fruit this year after heavy rain in the flowering season." Which part is kurang tepat?

stimulus.text: BATU - Apple farmers harvested 30% less fruit this year. They blamed unusually heavy rain during the flowering season.

items.reteach: Panen turun 30% (less), bukan naik.

items.prompt: Andika's email: What is the main purpose of the email?

stimulus.text: Dear Ms. Wulan, I am writing to ask for permission to leave school early on Friday. My family is travelling to Probolinggo for my grandfather's 70th birthday.
Our train leaves at 1 p.m., so I need to leave after the third lesson. I will ask my friend to share her notes with me. Yours sincerely, Andika (8C)

choices.say: to ask permission to leave school early

visual.text: to invite Ms. Wulan to a birthday party

choices.say: to invite Ms. Wulan to a birthday party

items.prompt: Andika's email: Why is his family going to Probolinggo?

stimulus.text: Dear Ms. Wulan, I am writing to ask for permission to leave school early on Friday. My family is travelling to Probolinggo for my grandfather's 70th birthday.
Our train leaves at 1 p.m., so I need to leave after the third lesson. I will ask my friend to share her notes with me. Yours sincerely, Andika (8C)

choices.say: to catch a train to Jakarta

items.reteach: Teks: "for my grandfather's 70th birthday".

items.prompt: Andika's email: How will Andika catch up on the lessons he misses?

Our train leaves at 1 p.m., so I need to leave after the third lesson. I will ask my friend to share her notes with me. Yours sincerely, Andika (8C)

choices.say: by asking Ms. Wulan for extra lessons

items.prompt: Clean & Green Day: Who wrote the announcement?

stimulus.text: ANNOUNCEMENT: Our school will hold a Clean & Green Day on Saturday, 14 March. All students should bring a broom or a small shovel. Each class will plant trees in the front yard.
The cleanest class will win a trip to Kebun Raya Purwodadi. Please wear sports clothes. - Student Council

items.reteach: Nama penulis ada di akhir pengumuman.

items.prompt: Clean & Green Day: What should students wear?

The cleanest class will win a trip to Kebun Raya Purwodadi. Please wear sports clothes. - Student Council

items.reteach: Teks: "Please wear sports clothes."

items.prompt: Clean & Green Day: What can we infer about the prize?

stimulus.text: ANNOUNCEMENT: Our school will hold a Clean & Green Day on Saturday, 14 March. All students should bring a broom or a small shovel. Each class will plant trees in the front yard.
The cleanest class will win a trip to Kebun Raya Purwodadi. Please wear sports clothes. - Student Council

choices.say: Students must pay for the trip.

items.prompt: Tari's letter: Where did Tari most likely live before?

stimulus.text: Dear Nisa, Thanks for your letter! Life in Jakarta is busy, but I miss the quiet mornings in Pacitan. Our new flat is on the 15th floor, so I can see the whole city.
I've joined a photography club and I'm learning to take photos at night. Could you send me a picture of our old beach? Love, Tari

items.reteach: Ia rindu pagi yang tenang di Pacitan dan menyebut "our old beach".

items.prompt: Tari's letter: What is Tari learning in her club?

stimulus.text: Dear Nisa, Thanks for your letter! Life in Jakarta is busy, but I miss the quiet mornings in Pacitan. Our new flat is on the 15th floor, so I can see the whole city.
I've joined a photography club and I'm learning to take photos at night. Could you send me a picture of our old beach? Love, Tari

choices.say: tell Kevin which act it will perform

Please send me your class's choice by 10 June so I can plan the order of the show. Dinner will be provided. Cheers, Kevin (Committee Leader)

items.prompt: Ticket-counter dialogue: Which line best fills the blank?

stimulus.text: Tourist: "Two tickets, please." Staff: "That's Rp240.000." Tourist: "___" Staff: "Sorry, we only accept cash or QRIS."

items.reteach: Jawaban petugas membahas cara bayar, jadi pertanyaannya tentang cara membayar.

items.prompt: Dialogue about a headache: Which line best fills the blank?

stimulus.text: Rina: "You look pale. Are you OK?" Dimas: "I've had a headache since this morning." Rina: "___" Dimas: "Good idea. I'll go there now."

visual.text: "Why don't you go to the school clinic?"

choices.say: "Why don't you go to the school clinic?"

items.reteach: Dimas menjawab "I'll go there now", jadi Rina menyarankan sebuah tempat yang tepat.

items.prompt: Market dialogue in Malang: Which line best fills the blank?

stimulus.text: Seller: "Fresh apples, Rp30.000 a kilo!" Ayu: "That's a bit expensive. ___" Seller: "OK, Rp27.000 for you."

items.reteach: Penjual menurunkan harga, berarti pembeli menawar.

items.prompt: Dialogue about Raka's essay: Which line best fills the blank?

stimulus.text: Teacher: "Raka, your essay is excellent!" Raka: "___" Teacher: "You deserve it. Keep it up."

visual.text: "Thank you, ma'am. I worked hard on it."

choices.say: "Thank you, ma'am. I worked hard on it."

items.reteach: Pujian dibalas dengan ucapan terima kasih.

items.prompt: Dialogue about the debate team: Which line best fills the blank?

stimulus.text: Sinta: "I didn't get into the debate team." Bayu: "___ You can try again next semester."

items.reteach: Kabar kurang menyenangkan ditanggapi dengan ungkapan simpati.

items.prompt: Hotel dialogue in Batu: Which line best fills the blank?

stimulus.text: Receptionist: "Good afternoon. How can I help you?" Guest: "___" Receptionist: "Certainly. A double room for two nights. May I see your ID?"

visual.text: "I'd like to book a room for two nights."

choices.say: "I'd like to book a room for two nights."

items.reteach: Resepsionis menyebut "a double room for two nights", jadi tamu memesan kamar.

items.prompt: Dialogue about the batik exhibition: Which line best fills the blank?

stimulus.text: Nadia: "Would you like to join us at the batik exhibition tomorrow?" Fira: "___ I have to look after my little brother."

items.reteach: Fira harus menjaga adiknya, jadi ia menolak ajakan dengan sopan.

items.prompt: Bus dialogue in Surabaya: Which line best fills the blank?

stimulus.text: Passenger: "Excuse me, does this bus go to Terminal Purabaya?" Driver: "___ You need bus number 5, across the road."

items.reteach: Sopir menyuruh naik bus nomor 5, berarti bus ini tidak ke Purabaya.

items.prompt: Dialogue about carrying chairs: Which line best fills the blank?

stimulus.text: Dimas: "Can you help me carry these chairs to the hall?" Raka: "___" Dimas: "Thanks a lot!"

items.reteach: Dimas berterima kasih, berarti Raka bersedia membantu.

items.prompt: Dialogue about homework: Which line best fills the blank?

stimulus.text: Mother: "Have you finished your homework?" Andi: "Not yet, Mum. ___" Mother: "All right, but don't stay up too late."

items.reteach: Andi menjawab "Not yet", lalu ibu mengingatkan agar tidak tidur larut.

items.prompt: Library dialogue: Which line best fills the blank?

stimulus.text: Librarian: "This book is three days overdue." Student: "___" Librarian: "That's all right. Please pay the Rp3.000 fine at the desk."

visual.text: "I'm sorry. I forgot to return it."

choices.say: "I'm sorry. I forgot to return it."

items.reteach: Buku terlambat dikembalikan, jadi siswa meminta maaf.

items.prompt: Karapan sapi dialogue: Which line best fills the blank?

stimulus.text: Guide: "This is karapan sapi, a traditional bull race in Madura." Tourist: "___" Guide: "Usually between August and October."

items.reteach: Pemandu menjawab dengan waktu (Agustus–Oktober), jadi pertanyaannya "When".

items.prompt: Dialogue about online classes: Which line best fills the blank?

stimulus.text: Ayu: "I think online classes are better than face-to-face classes." Bima: "___ I learn more when I can ask the teacher directly."

items.reteach: Bima memberi alasan yang berlawanan, jadi ia tidak setuju.

items.prompt: Bromo recount: Which order makes a good paragraph?

stimulus.text: (1) Then we walked to the crater and watched the sunrise. (2) Last holiday, my family visited Mount Bromo. (3) It was a tiring but unforgettable trip. (4) We left the hotel at 3 a.m. by jeep.

items.reteach: Recount: orientasi (2), urutan kejadian (4, 1), lalu kesan penutup (3).

items.prompt: Soekarno biography: Which order makes a good paragraph?

stimulus.text: (1) As a young man, he studied in Bandung. (2) Soekarno was born in Surabaya in 1901. (3) In 1945 he read the Proclamation of Independence with Hatta. (4) He became the first President of Indonesia.

items.reteach: Biografi disusun kronologis: lahir, sekolah, proklamasi 1945, lalu menjadi presiden.

items.prompt: Peacock story: Which order makes a good narrative?

stimulus.text: (1) When a storm came, the sparrow hid in a hole, but the peacock's long tail got stuck in a bush. (2) Since that day, the peacock has never laughed at the sparrow again.
(3) A proud peacock always laughed at a sparrow's plain brown feathers. (4) The sparrow called the other birds, and together they pulled the peacock free.

items.reteach: Orientasi (3), komplikasi (1), resolusi (4), lalu penutup (2).

items.prompt: Science fair recount: Which order makes a good paragraph?

stimulus.text: (1) After that, each team presented to the judges. (2) At the end, our team won second place. (3) Last Friday, our school held a science fair. (4) In the morning, we set up our water-filter model.

items.reteach: Mulai dari orientasi (3), pagi hari (4), setelah itu (1), dan akhirnya (2).

items.prompt: Ki Hajar Dewantara biography: Which order makes a good paragraph?

stimulus.text: (1) His birthday, 2 May, is now National Education Day. (2) In 1922 he founded Taman Siswa. (3) After independence, he became the first Minister of Education. (4) Ki Hajar Dewantara was born in 1889.

items.reteach: Kronologis: lahir 1889 (4), Taman Siswa 1922 (2), menteri setelah merdeka (3), lalu warisannya (1).

items.prompt: Madura study-tour recount: Which order makes a good paragraph?

stimulus.text: (1) We crossed the Suramadu Bridge early in the morning. (2) In the afternoon, we watched a karapan sapi race. (3) Last month, my class went on a study tour to Madura. (4) We got home tired but happy.

items.reteach: Orientasi (3), pagi (1), siang (2), lalu pulang (4).

items.prompt: Story of the lost wallet: Which order makes a good narrative?

stimulus.text: (1) Raka found a wallet near the bus stop. (2) The owner, an old woman, thanked him warmly. (3) He decided to take it to the police station at once. (4) Later that day, the police called the owner.

items.reteach: Raka menemukan dompet (1), memutuskan ke kantor polisi (3), polisi menghubungi pemilik (4), pemilik berterima kasih (2).

items.prompt: Storm recount: Which order makes a good paragraph?

stimulus.text: (1) Then the electricity went off, so we lit candles. (2) Last night, a heavy storm hit our village. (3) The next morning, we helped clear the fallen branches. (4) Strong winds blew down many trees.

items.reteach: Orientasi badai (2), angin merobohkan pohon (4), listrik padam (1), pagi berikutnya (3).

items.prompt: Text structure: The sentence in the box is the ___ of a recount text.

stimulus.text: Last Sunday, I joined a beach clean-up in Kenjeran with my scout group.

items.reteach: Orientation memperkenalkan siapa, kapan, dan di mana.

items.prompt: Narrative structure: Which part of a narrative is the sentence in the box most likely from?

stimulus.text: Suddenly, the boat's engine stopped in the middle of the lake, and dark clouds began to gather.

items.reteach: Complication = munculnya masalah (mesin mati, awan gelap).

items.prompt: Recount structure: The sentence in the box is most likely the …

stimulus.text: Overall, it was the best holiday I have ever had, and I hope to go back next year.

items.reteach: Reorientation berisi kesan atau penutup di akhir recount.

items.prompt: Story about Sari: Which sentence is the best resolution for the story?

stimulus.text: Sari got lost in a big market in Surabaya. She was scared and started to cry.

visual.text: A kind seller called the market office, and soon her mother came to pick her up.

choices.say: A kind seller called the market office, and soon her mother came to pick her up.

visual.text: Sari lives in a small house near the market.

choices.say: Sari lives in a small house near the market.

visual.text: One morning, Sari went to the market with her mother.

choices.say: One morning, Sari went to the market with her mother.

visual.text: Suddenly, Sari could not see her mother anywhere.

choices.say: Suddenly, Sari could not see her mother anywhere.

items.reteach: Resolution menyelesaikan masalah (Sari tersesat).

items.prompt: Ijen story: How is the guide's first sentence reported?

stimulus.text: At the edge of Ijen, the guide warned us. He said, "The crater is very deep. Stay behind the line."

visual.text: The guide said that the crater was very deep.

choices.say: The guide said that the crater was very deep.

visual.text: The guide said that the crater is being very deep.

choices.say: The guide said that the crater is being very deep.

visual.text: The guide said that the crater had been very deep.

choices.say: The guide said that the crater had been very deep.

visual.text: The guide told that the crater was very deep.

choices.say: The guide told that the crater was very deep.

items.reteach: Reported speech: is menjadi was; "told" membutuhkan objek (told us).

items.prompt: Riddle poem: What does "I" refer to?

stimulus.text: I fall from grey clouds and never get hurt. / I fill up the rivers and soften the dirt. / On tropical nights I drum on your roof. / What am I? Look outside for the proof.

items.reteach: Jatuh dari awan kelabu, mengisi sungai, dan mengetuk atap: hujan.

items.prompt: Grandfather poem: What is the main message of the poem?

stimulus.text: My grandfather's hands are rough and brown, / they planted every tree in town. / He never asked for thanks or pay - / the shade he made still cools my way.

visual.text: Grandfather's hard work still helps others today.

choices.say: Grandfather's hard work still helps others today.

visual.text: Grandfather wanted to be paid for planting trees.

choices.say: Grandfather wanted to be paid for planting trees.

visual.text: Trees are not useful in a town.

choices.say: Trees are not useful in a town.

visual.text: The writer does not like rough hands.

choices.say: The writer does not like rough hands.

items.reteach: Pohon yang ditanam kakek masih memberi keteduhan tanpa ia meminta imbalan.

items.prompt: Semeru text: Which sentence is an OPINION?

stimulus.text: Mount Semeru is the highest mountain in Java, at about 3,676 metres. It is the most beautiful mountain in Indonesia. Many climbers visit it every year.

visual.text: It is the most beautiful mountain in Indonesia.

choices.say: It is the most beautiful mountain in Indonesia.

visual.text: Mount Semeru is about 3,676 metres high.

choices.say: Mount Semeru is about 3,676 metres high.

visual.text: Many climbers visit it every year.

choices.say: Many climbers visit it every year.

visual.text: Semeru is the highest mountain in Java.

choices.say: Semeru is the highest mountain in Java.

items.reteach: Opini berisi penilaian pribadi (most beautiful); fakta bisa dibuktikan.

items.prompt: Canteen review: Which statement is a FACT?

stimulus.text: The new canteen opened on Monday. It sells rice, noodles, and fruit juice. In my view, the noodles are too salty, but the juice is the best in town.

visual.text: The juice is the best in town.

choices.say: The juice is the best in town.

visual.text: The canteen has the tastiest menu.

choices.say: The canteen has the tastiest menu.

items.reteach: Fakta dapat dibuktikan; "too salty" dan "the best" adalah pendapat.

items.prompt: Turtle story: What is the best title for the story?

stimulus.text: Tono, a little turtle, wanted to see the sea. The frogs said the trip was too long for him. Tono walked a little every day. After many weeks, he finally felt the waves on his feet.

visual.text: The Day the Sea Dried Up

choices.say: The Day the Sea Dried Up

items.reteach: Judul terbaik mencakup isi utama: Tono sampai ke laut dengan langkah kecil setiap hari.

items.prompt: Turtle story: What is the moral value of the story?

stimulus.text: Tono, a little turtle, wanted to see the sea. The frogs said the trip was too long for him. Tono walked a little every day. After many weeks, he finally felt the waves on his feet.

visual.text: Patience and steady effort help us reach our goals.

choices.say: Patience and steady effort help us reach our goals.

visual.text: We should always believe what others say.

choices.say: We should always believe what others say.

visual.text: Long trips are dangerous for small animals.

choices.say: Long trips are dangerous for small animals.

items.reteach: Tono tetap berjalan sedikit demi sedikit sampai berhasil.

items.prompt: Dewi Sartika biography: What can we infer about her?

stimulus.text: Dewi Sartika was born in Bandung in 1884. As a child, she taught her servants' children to read, writing with charcoal on roof tiles. In 1904 she opened a school for girls.

visual.text: She cared about education for girls from a young age.

choices.say: She cared about education for girls from a young age.

visual.text: She made roof tiles for a living.

choices.say: She made roof tiles for a living.

visual.text: She opened her school before she was ten.

choices.say: She opened her school before she was ten.

items.reteach: Sejak kecil ia mengajar membaca, lalu membuka sekolah perempuan pada 1904 (usia sekitar 20 tahun).

items.prompt: Cinema seat puzzle: Who sat at the far left?

stimulus.text: Four friends sat in a row at the cinema. Ani sat next to Budi. Citra sat at the far right. Dodi sat between Budi and Citra.

items.reteach: Citra paling kanan, Dodi di antara Budi dan Citra, Ani di sebelah Budi: Ani-Budi-Dodi-Citra.

items.prompt: Bus timetable puzzle: Which bus arrives in Surabaya first?

stimulus.text: Bus A leaves Malang at 07.00 and takes 2 hours to reach Surabaya. Bus B leaves at 07.30 and takes 1 hour 15 minutes. Bus C leaves at 08.00 and takes 1 hour.

items.reteach: A tiba 09.00, B tiba 08.45, C tiba 09.00. Bus B paling awal.

items.prompt: Fruit shop text: Which statement is TRUE?

stimulus.text: Pak Harun's shop sells only fruit. On Monday it sold 40 mangoes, twice as many as oranges. No bananas were sold that day.

visual.text: The shop sold 20 oranges on Monday.

choices.say: The shop sold 20 oranges on Monday.

visual.text: The shop sold 80 oranges on Monday.

choices.say: The shop sold 80 oranges on Monday.

items.reteach: 40 mangga = dua kali jeruk, jadi jeruk = 20.

items.prompt: Reference puzzle: In the second sentence, who does "She" most likely refer to?

stimulus.text: Lina gave her sister a novel because she had finished reading it. She was delighted because she had wanted that novel for months.

items.reteach: Yang senang karena sudah lama menginginkan buku itu adalah penerimanya, yaitu adik/kakak Lina.

items.prompt: Evening poem: Which word in the poem rhymes with "home"?

stimulus.text: The sun goes down behind the hill, / the rice fields lie so calm and still, / the farmers walk the path back home, / beneath the evening's purple dome.

items.reteach: Rima berpasangan: hill/still dan home/dome.

items.prompt: SmartPad advertisement: Which statement would the advertiser most likely agree with?

stimulus.text: Tired of carrying heavy books? Try SmartPad! One light tablet holds 500 e-books, and the battery lasts 12 hours. Get 10% off before 30 June!

visual.text: Carrying many paper books is a problem.

choices.say: Carrying many paper books is a problem.

visual.text: Paper books are lighter than tablets.

choices.say: Paper books are lighter than tablets.

visual.text: The tablet needs charging every hour.

choices.say: The tablet needs charging every hour.

items.reteach: Iklan dibuka dengan "Tired of carrying heavy books?", jadi pengiklan menganggapnya masalah.
